cues: It is the sensation in your ear.

text: Loudness is something different. It is the sensation in your ear. It grows with intensity, but not in proportion. By the Weber Fechner law, the sensation goes as the logarithm of the stimulus: L equals k log I. Ten times the intensity does not sound ten times as loud.
